Hi [Advisor],

Here are the results for the three topic-classifier configs (DistilRoBERTa, 5 classes, 1,000-example test set):

| Run | Test acc | Test macro-F1 | Train time |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline (lr 3e-5, bs 32) | 0.806 | 0.805 | 45 min (2,710 s) |

- **aug vs. baseline:** augmentation adds about 2.3 points of accuracy and macro-F1. However, a paired McNemar test on the test set gives p ≈ 0.20, so this gain isn't statistically significant yet.
- **aug-lr:** the run ran out of GPU memory at batch size 64 during epoch 7, so there are no test results. Up to that point it was at 0.839 validation accuracy after 6 epochs (aug finished at 0.847 val after 9 epochs). Too early to say whether it would have done better.

**Recommendation:** go with **aug** for now. It's the best completed run on both metrics, and it costs about 47% more training time. I plan to rerun aug-lr at a batch size that fits in memory (e.g. 32, or 64 with gradient accumulation) to check whether the higher learning rate helps.

Best,
